label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is user-controlled 'host' parameter from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Data flow: param ← request.getParameter → host ← param → resolveHost(host) (DNS) → openUrlByHostname(host) (outbound fetch). The separate DNS resolution and network fetch using unvalidated user input enables SSRF. The isNonPublicAddress check only validates loopback/site-local/link-local addresses, not external/internal resource access prevention. Attacker can provide arbitrary hostnames to reach internal services.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter assigned directly to host variable
SSRF sink: openUrlByHostname(host) uses unvalidated user-controlled host for outbound HTTPS request
openUrlByHostname constructs https://URL with user-host and opens stream
